TAPE SOLUTIONS FOR
WHITE GOODS INDUSTRY

Specialized adhesive tape solutions for home appliances manufactured under the DEFIGO brand — India's trusted name for White Goods tapes. Also available as authorized TESA distributor.

✦ DEFIGO — Our Own Brand + Authorized TESA Distributor
01
Air Permeability & Venting Tape
Also known as Air Vent Tape. Covers holes on appliances during PU foam injection — prevents foam from squeezing out while allowing air flow, avoiding pressure buildup. Hand tearable and available as die cuts.
PU Foam Process Air Permeable Die Cuts Hand Tearable
✦ DEFIGO Brand  ·  Also via TESA
02
Component Holding Tape
Prevents damage to glass shelves, loose bins, small parts and door hinges during transport. Reduces rattling, holds components firmly in place and leaves zero residue on removal.
Transport Protection Residue Free Blue / White
✦ DEFIGO Brand  ·  Also via TESA
03
Aluminium Foil Tape
Bright aluminium foil backing with pressure-sensitive adhesive. Attaches refrigerator and freezer coils tightly to polystyrene bodies for maximum temperature transfer. Excellent conformability, reflective & heat-conductive. Resistant to chemicals & vapours.
Heat Conductive Chemical Resistant Reflective Refrigeration
✦ DEFIGO Brand  ·  Also via TESA
04
PE Foam Tapes
Used to mount trims, emblems, displays and other components in the appliances industry. Flexible, secure bonding — excels on uneven or curved surfaces. Excellent cushioning properties with no sliding or creep.
Appliance Mounting Vibration Dampening Curved Surfaces
✦ DEFIGO Brand  ·  Also via TESA
05
Industrial High-Bond Double-Sided Tape
The strongest double-sided tape we offer — comparable to 3M VHB. Permanent interior and exterior bonding with outstanding ability to compensate static, dynamic and temperature stress through the full component lifecycle. Available through our TESA distribution partnership.
Permanent Bond Temperature Resistant Comparable to 3M VHB Interior & Exterior
Authorized TESA Distributor
06
Masking Tapes
Essential for painting — provides perfect sharp edges, easy to use and removes without residue from delicate surfaces indoors and outdoors. Rubber adhesives standard; silicone adhesive available for temps above 160°C.
Painting & Finishing Up to 160°C+ Residue Free
✦ DEFIGO Brand  ·  Also via TESA
07
BOPP Packaging Tapes
Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene film with water-based adhesive. Superior quality adhesive with high tack and adhesion strength for pilfer-proof carton sealing. Ideal for light-weight packaging, reinforcing, splicing, laminating, label protection and bundling. Available printed and non-printed.
Carton Sealing Printed / Plain High Tack Pilfer Proof
Available: DEFIGO
08
Double-Sided Tissue Tape
Ultra-thin tissue carrier with rubber or acrylic adhesive on both sides. Perfect for splicing, bonding lightweight materials and lamination tasks across the appliance assembly process.
Splicing Lamination Ultra Thin
Available: DEFIGO

Polyester Tapes
Source: Panamax · Ajit Industries (AIPL)
Panamax
Red Polyester Tape
Strong PET-backed tape with heat-resistant adhesive. Ideal for industrial bonding, mounting decorative profiles, moldings and trim parts. Excellent heat exposure resistance. Available in single and double-sided variants.
Heat Resistant Mounting Profile Bonding Red Color
Panamax
Single Sided Polyester Tape
Single-sided PET film tape with pressure-sensitive adhesive. Used for insulation of SMPS transformers, electrical relays and general-purpose applications up to 130°C. High tensile strength with excellent moisture resistance.
130°C Rated Transformer Insulation Electrical PET Backing
Panamax
Double Sided Polyester Tape (Red & White)
DS polyester tape with PET backing and modified acrylic adhesive on both sides. Available in DS White (with siliconized paper liner) and DS Red variants. Used for flex media joining, foam board fixing, glass/acrylic sheet joining and film splicing.
Double Sided Red & White Options Film Splicing Acrylic Adhesive
Ajit Industries
High Temperature Polyester Tape
Thermosetting adhesive polyester tape designed for elevated temperature environments. Highly suitable for SMPS transformers and electrical relays. Excellent solvent resistance and insulation properties. Withstands continuous high-heat industrial applications.
High Temp Solvent Resistant Transformer Use Electrical Grade
Foam Tapes
Source: Adhesive Specialities · Selmex Industries · Egret Mfg
Adhesive Specialities
EVA Foam Tape (S/S & D/S)
Closed-cell ethylene-vinyl acetate foam tape with excellent holding strength. Eco-friendly alternative to PVC — temperature resistant, waterproof and UV-stable. Used in white goods component holding, refrigeration, stationery and die-cuts. Available single and double-sided.
Closed Cell White Goods Temperature Resistant Die-Cut Available
Adhesive Specialities
PE Foam Tape (S/S & D/S)
Polyethylene foam tape providing permanent bonding between lightweight materials. Flame-retardant, ideal for indoor use. Excellent for automotive interiors, printing, hook manufacturing, door sealing and skirting applications. Available in 1mm, 2mm thicknesses.
Flame Retardant Door Sealing Automotive Interior 1–2mm Thick
Adhesive Specialities
EPDM Foam Tape (Glazing Tape)
Also known as Glazing Tape. Closed-cell EPDM rubber with hotmelt adhesive — excellent UV, ozone and heat resistance (-40°C to +105°C). Seals gap between glass panels and window/door frames. Anti-vibration. Available SS/DS in 3mm and 6mm variants.
Glazing / Window -40°C to 105°C UV Resistant 3mm & 6mm
Egret Mfg
PU Foam Tape
Polyurethane foam tape offering superior cushioning and flexibility compared to PE/EVA foam. Excellent compression recovery and vibration damping properties. Widely used in automotive, construction gap-filling, HVAC sealing and industrial bonding applications.
Superior Cushioning Gap Filling HVAC Vibration Damping
Kraft Paper & Eco Tapes
Source: Ajit Industries — AIPL Mission Green
AIPL Mission Green
Self-Adhesive Kraft Paper Tape
FSC-certified biodegradable paper tape that replaces non-biodegradable BOPP plastic tape. Available in 60 & 80 GSM paper with up to 3-color custom printing. Fully recyclable and compliant with Plastic Waste Management Rules 2016. Sustainable packaging solution.
FSC Certified Biodegradable Custom Print 60 & 80 GSM
AIPL Mission Green
Water-Activated Kraft Paper Tape (KP-90)
High-strength reinforced kraft paper tape activated by water for a permanent, tamper-evident seal. 90%+ recycled content. FSC certified. Available in 60 GSM — popular in 60mm×50m and 72mm×50m sizes. Provides a strong green packaging alternative.
Water Activated Tamper Evident Recyclable 90% Recycled
AIPL Mission Green
Reinforced Kraft Paper Tape
High-strength green packaging tape with FSC-certified kraft paper reinforced for heavy-duty carton sealing. Biodegradable alternative to BOPP that retains strong adhesion across standard shipping and warehouse conditions. Available in 60 GSM paper.
Reinforced Heavy-Duty Green Packaging Carton Sealing
Duct Tape
Source: Panamax
Panamax
Cloth Duct Tape
Heavy-duty cloth-backed duct tape with strong rubber adhesive. Tough, flexible and conformable — ideal for sealing, bundling, repairing, pipe wrapping and general industrial fixing. Can fix leaking pipes, hold materials together and seal heavy packages. Hand-tearable.
Hand Tearable Pipe Repair Bundling Grey / Silver
Mirror Mounting Tapes
Source: Tesa · Panamax
TESA
Tesa® Powerbond Mirror Mounting Tape
TÜV Rheinland-certified double-sided foam tape for furniture and bathroom mirror mounting. Bonds mirrors up to 70×70 cm, 4 mm thick. Superior holding power even in humid environments — no nails or screws required. Certified for furniture mirror mounting (Tesa 4952).
TÜV Certified Bathroom Safe Up to 70×70 cm No Screws
Panamax
Mirror Mounting Tape (Panamax)
Double-sided foam-based mirror mounting tape engineered for strong, permanent bonds on glass, tiles, wood and metal. Suitable for interior and exterior applications. Provides a clean, seamless installation without damaging the underlying surface.
Double Sided Glass / Tile / Metal Interior & Exterior Permanent Bond
Roller Masking Tape
Source: Panamax
Panamax
Roller Masking Tape
Specially engineered masking tape for roller painting applications. Provides clean, sharp edges and easy removal without residue on delicate surfaces. Suitable for indoor and outdoor painting. Available with rubber adhesive (standard) or silicone adhesive for temperatures above 160°C.
Roller Painting Sharp Edges Residue Free Up to 160°C+

Slab Cast Shuttering Tape
Innovative construction tape ensuring seamless shuttering processes with superior adhesion and durability. Protects slab forms from concrete leakage and provides a clean release surface. Strong bond to concrete shuttering panels. Excellent for civil and infrastructure projects.
Construction Concrete Forms Slab Casting Clean Release

Tesa® 60950 Anti-Slip Tape (Black)
Professional anti-skid tape for factory floors, stairwells, industry areas and exhibition halls. Very good adhesion on demanding surfaces. PVC-backed with durable grip texture. Hand tearable, no shrinkage after application. Anti-slip effect lasts 1–2 years in normal use areas.

Flexo Printing Plate Mounting Carpet Fixing Double Sided

Dry Wall Joint Tape
Paper or fibre mesh tape for reinforcing drywall (plasterboard) joints before plastering or painting. Provides a smooth, crack-resistant finish. Easy to embed in joint compound and sand flush. Essential for interior construction and partition wall installations.

Cross Filament Tape
Cross-woven fiberglass filament tape with premium adhesive — high resistance to stretching and breaking. Ideal for heavy packaging, pallet unitizing, bundling pipes and steel coils, reinforcing cartons and e-commerce applications. Moisture and abrasion resistant.
Cross-Woven Fiberglass Pallet Unitizing Heavy Packaging Abrasion Resistant

HDPE Tape

HDPE Material Packaging Chemical Resistant Moisture Proof

Heat Sealing Tape (Teflon)
PTFE (Teflon) coated heat sealing tape for sealing machines and impulse sealers. Provides a non-stick surface that resists high temperatures. Used in food packaging, medical device sealing, and industrial heat-seal equipment to ensure clean, reliable seals with long service life.
PTFE / Teflon Non-Stick Impulse Sealers Food Packaging
